set.body:
Scope: ../spatial4s, ../image4s geometry/grid APIs, ../reframe4s.

Deliverable: Use spatial4s dimensions, frames, points/vectors, units and conventions as the shared coordinate authority, preserving image-specific grid/axis semantics.

Acceptance:
- Volume and mesh composition uses identical nominal frame types; redundant frame algebra/conversions are deleted.
- Wrong-frame and dimension rejection plus unit/convention and mapping tests pass on both platforms.
- Grid ordering/value semantics and existing image/transform oracles remain unchanged.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U2: Adopt spatial4s coordinate types in image4s and reframe4s
